proposals.title: Add a drawdown guard
proposals.note: Pause trading after the account falls a set amount from its peak. Freqtrade has a max-drawdown and stop-loss guard, and Vibe Trading has an order guard with a halt switch.

proposals.title: Add a backup free data source
proposals.note: Prices and SEC filings are the only inputs today, so one outage stops the run. Vibe Trading has about 45 data loaders.

proposals.title: Write a quick-start in the README
proposals.note: Setup is the weakest area: a broker login, secrets and many workflows with no walkthrough. Freqtrade's docs are the model.

proposals.title: Add more automated tests
proposals.note: 152 tests today against Freqtrade's 1,619 and over 1,000 test files in Vibe Trading. Start with the order and risk code.

proposals.title: Backtest with costs and stops
proposals.note: Replay the strategies with fees, slippage and trailing stops at portfolio level, the way NautilusTrader and Jesse do.

proposals.title: Track more performance numbers
proposals.note: Add drawdown, profit factor and win rate to the daily scorecard next to the S&P comparison. Freqtrade and Jesse report these.

proposals.title: Stop depending on free Actions minutes
proposals.note: Schedules were paused when the 2,000 free minutes ran out. Run less often, or move the heavy jobs elsewhere.

proposals.title: Add significance tests for strategies
proposals.note: Jesse runs Monte Carlo and significance tests so a lucky backtest is not trusted.

proposals.title: Widen the indicator library
proposals.note: Ten strategies and a handful of indicators, against Jesse's 300+ and Freqtrade's TA-Lib.

proposals.title: Write richer reports
proposals.note: TradingAgents saves one readable HTML report per run with the reasoning behind each decision, and Vibe Trading sends PDF reports.

proposals.title: Document how each role works
proposals.note: Write one short page per role: what it reads, decides and writes. Freqtrade scores 10 here.

proposals.title: Keep a changelog
proposals.note: Write down each change so it is clear how the bot is improving. Vibe Trading scores 10 here.

proposals.title: Move more settings into the rules file
proposals.note: Make thresholds and limits editable in one place. NautilusTrader scores 10 here.

proposals.title: Make the practice mode behave like the real run
proposals.note: Run the paper lane through the same order and risk checks as live trading. Freqtrade scores 9 here.

proposals.title: Cut the running cost
proposals.note: Run the heavy jobs less often so the free minutes last the whole month. Awesome Systematic Trading scores 9 here.

proposals.title: Size positions from the risk budget
proposals.note: Pick share counts from the stop distance and a fixed percent of cash at risk. Freqtrade scores 8 here.

proposals.title: Log every adviser decision
proposals.note: Keep a record of what each adviser flagged or halted, and why. Vibe Trading scores 8 here.

proposals.title: Add one more strategy to the vote
proposals.note: Test a new rule-based strategy in the paper lane before it votes. Awesome Systematic Trading scores 9 here.

proposals.title: Give the advisers more tools
proposals.note: Let the advisory agents read more data. They still never place orders. TradingAgents scores 9 here.

proposals.title: Make the daily run more dependable
proposals.note: Retry a failed run once and send an alert if it still fails. Freqtrade scores 8 here.

proposals.title: Take first place on AI safety limits
proposals.note: Only Vibe Trading (8) is ahead. Add a signed daily decision log of every adviser action and a test that fails the build if any adviser path can place an order or raise a limit. Then the safest AI design in the field is also the one that proves it.

proposals.title: Build the strictest risk controls in the field
proposals.note: Four rivals are ahead, led by NautilusTrader (9). Add a per-order pre-trade checklist in the report, a what-if stress test (every stock down 10%) and a limit on how much of the account moves together. Risk is the one area a small cash account can do better than the big engines.

proposals.title: Lead on fundamentals and earnings
proposals.note: Three rivals are ahead (Vibe Trading 9, Fincept 8). Add earnings dates and key ratios per stock next to the SEC filings, skip new buys just before earnings, and show the reason in the report.

proposals.title: Be the cheapest to run
proposals.note: Only Awesome Systematic Trading (a reading list) is truly cheaper. Show the monthly cost in minutes and AI tokens on the dashboard, add a monthly budget that pauses the heavy jobs first, and skip jobs when nothing changed.

proposals.title: Add walk-forward strategy optimization
proposals.note: Freqtrade and Jesse (9) tune strategies with hyperopt and Optuna. Add a walk-forward search that tunes on one period, tests on the next, and only proposes a change that survives the significance test the Quant already has.
